title: Construction and comparison of preeclampsia prediction models using logistic regression and machine learning.
summary: In a retrospective cohort of 404 pregnant women, 45 of them with preeclampsia, logistic regression, support-vector machine, random-forest and extreme-gradient-boosting classifiers used clinical and placental-ultrasound predictors and were internally evaluated. Random forest had the highest AUC (0.781) and logistic regression the best out-of-fold calibration (Brier 0.090). The single-center cohort and small event count limit generalization, and external validation is still needed. The result is reported in BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making.
